title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. At what time does the industrial IoT lesson start?
tasks.audioText: The industrial systems tutor will discuss connected production equipment on Tuesday at ten thirty. Students should bring the network architecture diagram. The lesson will trace sensor data through a gateway to a monitoring platform and explain why device identity and approved network settings matter.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which network document is required for the session?
tasks.audioText: The industrial systems tutor will discuss connected production equipment on Tuesday at ten thirty. Students should bring the network architecture diagram. The lesson will trace sensor data through a gateway to a monitoring platform and explain why device identity and approved network settings matter.

tasks.prompt: An industrial Internet of Things system connects sensors, equipment and software services. A sensor sends readings to a gateway, which transfers selected information to another system. Device identity, communication settings and access controls are important because connected equipment can affect production processes. A system diagram helps engineers understand the data path and devices involved. Reading 1. What may a gateway do?
options: Transfer sensor information to another system
Replace the controller in every network
Measure the physical distance between devices

tasks.prompt: Why do device identity and access controls matter?
options: Connected equipment can affect production processes
Network diagrams always contain confidential data
Device names determine the price of equipment
Access controls replace the need for maintenance records

tasks.prompt: Selected sensor data ___ to a monitoring platform.
A connected sensor has been added to the production network. Which information should be verified?
options: Device identity and approved communication settings

tasks.prompt: A device that connects local equipment to another network or system is a ___.
Before enabling data transfer, which records should be checked?
options: Check the device register and approved network configuration before enabling data transfer.
Use the newest configuration file in the shared folder without checking its revision.
Confirm that display settings match the previous training session.
Check only the user access list; review device and network records later.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of industrial IoT systems in a logical order.
options: Confirm where the data is monitored
Trace the data path through the gateway
Check its identity and approved settings
correctOrder: Check its identity and approved settings
Trace the data path through the gateway
Confirm where the data is monitored

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words describing an industrial IoT data path. Explain the roles of a sensor, gateway and monitoring platform, and mention one security consideration.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the sensor, gateway and monitoring platform are identified in the data path (0–2); the response explains how information moves between them and includes one relevant security consideration (0–2); the explanation is logically organised with understandable grammar (0–2); industrial-IoT/network vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
